title: Hypercontractivity on a torus and juntas for Lipschitz functions
description: Trigonometric polynomials and Fejer means on a torus; the heat operators and three inequalities for them. A logarithmic Sobolev inequality on the circle, with Rothaus's lemma. Hypercontractivity of the heat operators on the circle and on a torus of any dimension. Austin's theorem: a function on a cube that is Lipschitz for the sup distance is close to a function of a bounded number of coordinates, with an explicit bound that does not depend on the dimension. All proofs are complete; no theorem of the literature is assumed.
